proposed_title: Humanitarian operations need dated, country-specific evidence
what_happened: Fresh GETs retrieved an exact UN News Haiti field report and an exact WHO Gaza statement. They demonstrate useful source-page retrieval but do not support one combined current world-news claim.
key_facts: FACT: UN News published a dated first-person Haiti operational report.
OFFICIAL_CLAIM: WHO published its attributed Gaza warning in 2025.
UNKNOWN: neither page establishes a new development on 2 September 2026.

primary_sources.claim_supported: WHO/IPC famine classification and health warning for Gaza at publication date
primary_sources.independence: UN health body statement; attribution retained, not treated as same-day 2026 status

independent_sources.claim_supported: Humanitarian operational account from Haiti at publication date
independent_sources.independence: UN editorial report from a different operation and interview trail

contradictory_evidence: Different crises cannot corroborate each other.
Institutional testimony needs country-specific independent evidence.
uncertainty: High on retrieval and page identity, low on any current synthesis; therefore HOLD.
context: The world desk tests source diversity without conflating unrelated evidence.
why_it_matters: A disciplined desk rejects a headline list when sources do not converge on a current material story.
strategic_angle: HOLD and conduct focused current retrieval on one event.
